coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: One of five variable items matches at the conceptual level (20%): comparison of ground-truth, subsampled, and MDGEN-upsampled trajectories. The specified constants and dependent-variable definitions are not reproduced.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output replaces the pooled 30k-frame test-peptide data with new molecular systems and simulation protocols, omits fixed crop/frame-selection settings and full-protein inference, and uses 2 fs reference sampling rather than the required 100 fs. Although it includes 10 ps subsampling, it does not specify the required 10 ps-to-100 fs upsampling comparison. Its autocorrelation uses normalized angle covariance instead of the mean cosine of angle differences and evaluates up to 1 ps rather than 100 ps. Dynamic content as the negative derivative of autocorrelation with respect to log-timescale is absent.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the expected recovery of sub-ps oscillations, close agreement with ground-truth autocorrelation, and non-monotonic dynamic content in MDGEN-upsampled trajectories, contrasted with their absence in subsampled trajectories.
